 - AS Watson - Warehouse Employee Kruidvat (start immediately) Wat ga je doen? 
Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the order for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process! 
You work in a 2 shift system: - 07:00 - 16:00 (morning shift) - 16:00 - 00:00 (afternoon shift) 
These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks. Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at A.S. Watson's modern distribution center. This is the warehouse responsible for supplying online orders for Kruidvat and Trekpleister in the Netherlands, Belgium and France. The work atmosphere is informal and energetic. Colleagues help each other and together you ensure the best results. The location is easily accessible from Arnhem, Amersfoort, Veenendaal and Wageningen among others. Coming by car? You can park for free right in front of the building! The warehouse is also easily accessible by public transport. You get opportunities to develop yourself through Olympia. For example with free Dutch or English language courses. 
 Wie ben je? - You can speak English or Dutch - You are available for at least 2 working days per week - You are willing to work in a 2-shift system - You are physically capable of performing active work, such as walking and lifting - Experience is not required, but motivation and commitment are important Wat mag je verwachten? -...

Ready for a new challenge as a Warehouse Employee in Heijen? Do you enjoy active work, speak English, and want to work in a two-shift operation? This could be the perfect opportunity for you. Start quickly and grow within a modern warehouse environment.

What are you going to do?
As a Warehouse Employee in Heijen, you will help ensure that orders are processed quickly and correctly. Together with your colleagues, you play an important role in keeping the warehouse running smoothly and efficiently.

Your tasks include:

- Scanning orders using a handheld scanner
- Unpacking and checking incoming orders
- Sorting parcels and placing them on pallets
- Ensuring orders are ready for further processing and shipment

This is an active full-time warehouse role where you'll be on the move throughout the day and work as part of a motivated team in a modern logistics environment.

What do we offer?
Working through Adecco means great benefits and opportunities for growth!

- Attractive salary starting from € 14,99 gross per hour (day shift), increasing up to € 24.28 gross per hour for evening shifts.
- Travel allowance of € 0.21 per km.
- 8% holiday allowance paid on top of your salary.
- 25 paid vacation days per year so you can enjoy a good work–life balance.
- Immediate participation in a pension scheme, helping you secure your future.
- Real growth opportunities at Arvato, with the chance of a permanent contract when you perform well.
- Free access to hundreds of online courses through the Adecco Academy to support your professional development.

Where will you work?
This company handles the logistics for well-known brands. You’ll be working in a large, well-organized warehouse in Heijen, alongside colleagues from all over Europe. The workplace is clean and structured, and English is the main language spoken on the floor. 

What do we ask?
- You must be at least 18 years old
- You must speak English at a communicative level, at least A2
- Own housing and own transport

We are looking for candidates for a production position, who are able to work both in a team and independently.

Main responsibilities:

- Installing door components
- Setting up, checking, and operating machinery
- Inspecting the quality of materials and finished products
- Cleaning and maintaining a tidy workspace
- Thinking along and contributing to structural improvement opportunities

Ideally, you have experience in a similar position and feel at home in a production environment where products are assembled using the appropriate machines and tools.

- You have experience with assembling and mounting components
- You are technically skilled and enjoy hands-on work
- You enjoy working as part of a team
- You have a valid driver’s license
- You speak English well

Fixed hours, a predictable schedule, and room to grow if you want to. Apply now and start as a Warehouse Employee this week. You work across different departments in a warehouse in Wijchen. You receive goods, check them for quality, and process them in the system. You also pick orders and prepare them for shipment. You work as part of a fixed team of Warehouse Employees but carry out many tasks independently. Each section of the warehouse has its own products and its own way of working, and you switch between them with ease.

We expect the following of a Warehouse Employee:  - Good command of Dutch or English
 - Available on short notice
 - Willing to obtain your EPT certificate (costs are covered)
 
 You work accurately, adapt easily, and handle variety well. You take your tasks seriously and work well with the people around you.

As a Regulatory Affairs Specialist, you oversee the regulatory process throughout the entire lifecycle of a product. You prepare and submit new registrations, maintain dossiers, and manage variations and renewals for your own portfolio of countries. 
Your work is closely connected to the rest of the organization. You collaborate daily with colleagues from QA, QC, logistics and sales to make sure products can be registered, released and shipped without delays. Regulatory Affairs sits at the center of this process: if the documentation is not correct or complete, products cannot move forward. 
At the moment the team is working on several large projects, including the transfer of registrations to a new manufacturing site and the integration of dossiers from newly acquired companies.
